scope: Read-only UX, EN/zh-TW/ja copy coverage, and extraction error/retry operability review. Excludes native helper implementation and live website flow.

findings.title: Narrow layout renders duplicate extraction details and duplicate input IDs
evidence: artifacts/extraction-review-02/files/src/ui/main.ts: render() appends inline-details for the selected row when narrow.matches, then also renders detailsHtml() into #details and hides that element.
detailsHtml() repeats retry-extraction-password and retry-password-hint IDs. The retry handler queries #retry-extraction-password globally rather than resolving it from the clicked extraction detail.
The supplied extraction-ui test covers a failed extraction retry and secret omission, but does not cover narrow-layout duplicate details or per-detail input resolution.
findings.impact: Hidden duplicate detail markup makes IDs non-unique and leaves retry password selection coupled to document order. The visible inline detail currently precedes the hidden sidebar detail, but that is a brittle assumption for DOM changes and UI tests.
findings.minimalFollowup: Do not render the hidden sidebar detail body while narrow.matches, and resolve the retry password input from the clicked button's closest .extraction-detail.
findings.notes: This report is limited to snapshot 02; no later working-tree delta was reviewed in this pass.
